embedded_image_rights_review: Embedded JSON references include third-party EatingWell/Meredith and Chefkoch photo hosts. These recipe-manager fixture records do not supply image-specific license, copyright, attribution, or permission fields. Fixture repository licenses are not treated as licenses for third-party photos.

image.permission_evidence: permission evidence URL if permission is used instead of a recognized image-specific license
image.publication_allowed: optional explicit boolean; false always suppresses

omission_reason: No persisted recipe image fields with image-specific display rights and provenance. Embedded source-body image references are not assumed to be licensed recipe photographs.
policy: Select explicit image/image_url fields only with image-specific license and attribution or explicit publication permission with evidence URL; never infer image rights from recipe prose licenses. No network requests, downloads or invented URLs.
